The Technologies Behind GenoGluco

From continuous glucose monitoring to genomics, GenoGluco integrates multiple health data technologies through Synora Intelligence™.

Genomics

Genomic information includes genetic variants, SNPs, and polygenic risk scores that can contribute to understanding inherited risk factors.

Genetic Data
Variant Analysis
Risk Scoring

Key Parameters

SNPsGenetic variantsFamily historyPolygenic risk information

Genetic information can contribute to risk assessment but does not independently determine whether someone will develop diabetes. It should always be interpreted with clinical context.

Medical Disclaimer

GenoGluco provides health information and risk-assessment insights based on available data. AI-generated results are not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis, treatment, or advice. Users should consult an appropriately qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.
